title: 6 Day Luxury Fly-In to Mara River Crossing Safari
description: This 6-day luxury fly-in safari takes you straight into the heart of Tanzania’s greatest wildlife spectacles the Serengeti Migration and the Ngorongoro Crater. Skip long road transfers as you fly directly to key wildlife zones, maximizing your time in the wilderness. Spend multiple days tracking the Great Wildebeest Migration across the Serengeti plains and northern river corridors, where dramatic predator action unfolds. Conclude your journey with a breathtaking game drive inside the Ngorongoro Crater, home to one of the highest densities of wildlife in Africa. Premium lodges, professional guides, seamless transfers, and unforgettable scenery make this the ideal safari for travelers seeking comfort, efficiency, and exceptional wildlife encounters.
highlights: Scenic fly-in access to Serengeti no long road drives
Game drives across central, northern, or western Serengeti (season-based)
Possible Mara or Grumeti River crossing sightings
Luxury lodges and tented camps for a premium safari experience
Explore Ngorongoro Crater “Africa’s Garden of Eden”
Professional guides, 4×4 safari vehicle, and full board meals included
Ideal blend of comfort, adventure, and wildlife photography opportunities
excludes: Personal expenses (souvenirs, tips, phone calls, etc.)

itinerary.title: Fly into Serengeti National Park
itinerary.text: Fly from Arusha/Zanzibar to the Serengeti. Upon arrival, meet your safari guide and begin your first game drive across the endless plains. Explore wildlife-rich areas as you head toward your camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Following the Great Migration
itinerary.text: Spend the entire day tracking the Great Migration herds, witnessing thousands of wildebeest and zebras on the move. Search for big cats and other wildlife along the riverbanks and plains. Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park, then continue your game drive until evening.Dinner and overnight in Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti → Central Serengeti
itinerary.text: After breakfast, begin your journey from the Northern Serengeti to the Central Serengeti. Enjoy game drives en route, exploring different habitats known for lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, and abundant plains game.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti → Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.text: Start the day with a final morning game drive in the Serengeti. After lunch, depart for the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, enjoying breathtaking views as you climb into the highlands. Arrive at your lodge on the crater rim.Dinner and overnight in Ngorongoro Highlands.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater → Tarangire National Park
itinerary.text: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a spectacular game drive on the crater floor, home to the Big Five and incredible wildlife diversity. After lunch, leave the crater and continue to Tarangire National Park.

itinerary.title: Tarangire → Arusha → Departure
itinerary.text: Enjoy a morning game drive in Tarangire, famous for elephants, baobab trees, and rich wildlife. After the safari, drive back to Arusha for drop-off at your hotel or transfer to the airport for your flight.End of tour.

summary: This 6-day luxury fly-in safari takes you straight into the heart of Tanzania’s greatest wildlife spectacles the Serengeti Migration and the Ngorongoro Crater.
